name: invalid-package

error.messageIncludes: app must be a non-empty string.

note: calibrated from a real run. launch reads `app` before it validates packageName, so this input is rejected with 'app must be a non-empty string.' and the packageName check is never reached; the brief's expected /package/i message is unreachable for its own input. Adding "app":"Chrome" to the same packageName does report 'packageName must be a valid Android package name.' (captured too, and that path is already unit-covered in src/lib/actionValidation.packageName.test.ts). The input is replayed exactly as the brief prescribes; only the expectation follows the observed message.
